name: Kerbal Attachment System (MMW)
abstract: Winches, struts, and pipes to connect vessels in EVA without docking them, with action groups for winches and the JS-1 socket
description: Minmus Machine Works fork of https://github.com/ihsoft/KAS. Adds action groups to set a winch's cable length, detach a winch connector, and disconnect a link from the JS-1 joint socket (from duclingg/KAS). It replaces the official KAS package (provides and conflicts with it), so mods that depend on KAS still install.
author: IgorZ
